//! Reference vectors from crosstalk at the pinned commit (7f8a2fb), for the
//! bench's resource canonicaliser: every input runs through the functions
//! the AI Village labels were made with.
//!
//! `url`: `ai_village::resource::from_url` (copied below: `tool_url_locator`,
//! then the first locator of `SitesConfig::default()` on a `GET`).
//! `plain`: `url_locator` alone. `remote`: `ai_village::resource::from_remote`
//! (copied below). `kind`: `ai_village::resource::kind` of the `url` locator.
//! `repository`: `Locator::repository(host, owner, name)`.
//!
//! Usage: resource-vectors <inputs.json> <repository-triples.json> > vectors.json
use crosstalk_flow::extract::SitesConfig;
use crosstalk_flow::extract::http::HttpRequest;
use crosstalk_flow::extract::resource::{RepoId, tool_url_locator, url_locator};
use crosstalk_spec::derived::flow::resource::Locator;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// crosstalk-eval `datasets::ai_village::resource::from_url`, verbatim but
/// keeping the error.
fn from_url(sites: &SitesConfig, text: &str) -> Result<Locator, String> {
    let url = tool_url_locator(text).map_err(|e| format!("{e:?}"))?;
    let site = sites
        .apply(&HttpRequest::get(url.clone()))
        .and_then(|access| access.locators.into_iter().next());
    Ok(site.unwrap_or(url))
}

/// crosstalk-eval `datasets::ai_village::resource::from_remote`, verbatim.
fn from_remote(text: &str) -> Option<Locator> {
    let repo = RepoId::parse(text, None)?;
    repo.forge_parts()?;
    Some(repo.locator().clone())
}

/// crosstalk-eval `datasets::ai_village::resource::kind`, verbatim.
fn kind(locator: &Locator) -> Option<&'static str> {
    match locator {
        Locator::Repository { .. } => Some("repository"),
        Locator::File {
            host: Some(host), ..
        } if host.0.contains('/') && !host.0.starts_with('/') => Some("repo_file"),
        Locator::Url { .. } => Some("url"),
        Locator::File { .. } | Locator::Mcp { .. } | Locator::Opaque { .. } => None,
    }
}

fn result(result: Result<Locator, String>) -> Value {
    match result {
        Ok(locator) => json!({ "ok": locator }),
        Err(error) => json!({ "err": error }),
    }
}

fn read(path: &str) -> Value {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_default();
    serde_json::from_str(&text).unwrap_or(Value::Null)
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let inputs = read(args.get(1).map_or("inputs.json", String::as_str));
    let triples = read(args.get(2).map_or("repositories.json", String::as_str));
    let sites = SitesConfig::default();
    let vectors: Vec<Value> = inputs
        .as_array()
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(Value::as_str)
        .map(|text| {
            let url = from_url(&sites, text);
            let kind = url.as_ref().ok().and_then(kind);
            json!({
                "input": text,
                "url": result(url),
                "plain": result(url_locator(text).map_err(|e| format!("{e:?}"))),
                "remote": from_remote(text),
                "kind": kind,
            })
        })
        .collect();
    let repositories: Vec<Value> = triples
        .as_array()
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(|t| {
            let [h, o, n] = t.as_array()?.as_slice() else {
                return None;
            };
            let (h, o, n) = (h.as_str()?, o.as_str()?, n.as_str()?);
            let out = Locator::repository(h, o, n).map_err(|e| format!("{e:?}"));
            Some(json!({ "host": h, "owner": o, "name": n, "repository": result(out) }))
        })
        .collect();
    let out = json!({ "crosstalk": "7f8a2fb", "vectors": vectors, "repositories": repositories });
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap_or_default());
}
